name: every_starter
caption:
IF OUR RAPTORS CORE FIVE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🧬 Scottie = Mew: learns every move, 23.5 points a night through 8 games
🐂 RJ = Tauros: a Toronto-born bull, 21.6 points a night through 9 games
🥷 Quickley = Ninjask: quick by name, 5.8 assists a night through 8 games
🐼 Collin = Pangoro: our bruiser, 5.0 rebounds in 22.1 minutes a night
😴 Poeltl = Snorlax: nobody moves him, 61.1% from the field through 7 games

Who did we get wrong? 👇
